title: Why Do You Hide Yourself?

questions.question: Why, O Lord, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:1 (ESV): "Why, O Lord, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?"

questions.question: In arrogance the wicked hotly pursue the who?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:2 (ESV): "In arrogance the wicked hotly pursue the poor;"

questions.question: For the wicked boasts of the desires of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:3 (ESV): "For the wicked boasts of the desires of his soul..."

questions.question: In the pride of his face the wicked does not do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:4 (ESV): "In the pride of his face the wicked does not seek him; all his thoughts are, 'There is no God.'"

questions.question: He says in his heart, "I shall not be moved; throughout all generations I shall not meet what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:6 (ESV): "...throughout all generations I shall not meet adversity."

questions.question: His mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:7 (ESV): "His mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and oppression;"

questions.question: He lurks in ambush like a what in his thicket?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:9 (ESV): "he lurks in ambush like a lion in his thicket;"

questions.question: He says in his heart, "God has forgotten, he has hidden his face, he will never what?"
Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up your what; forget not the afflicted.
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:12 (ESV): "Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up your hand; forget not the afflicted."

questions.question: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call his wickedness to account till you find what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:15 (ESV): "...call his wickedness to account till you find none."

questions.question: The Lord is king forever and ever; the nations perish from his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:16 (ESV): "The Lord is king forever and ever; the nations perish from his land."

questions.question: O Lord, you hear the desire of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:17 (ESV): "O Lord, you hear the desire of the afflicted;"

questions.question: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that man who is of the earth may strike what no more?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:18 (ESV): "so that man who is of the earth may strike terror no more."

questions.question: He sits in ambush in the villages; in hiding places he murders the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:8 (ESV): "...in hiding places he murders the innocent."

questions.question: His eyes stealthily watch for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 10:8 (ESV): "...his eyes stealthily watch for the helpless;"

key_verse_text: But you do see, for you note mischief and vexation, that you may take it into your hands; to you the helpless commits himself; you have been the helper of the fatherless.
